source_expression: TOM := InverseOccam[ Arch[ C[J[T]], E[C[J[T]]; InvLog[phi]] ] ] qualified_by forward_T_precedence
source_frontend: parse_source_expression expands textual references c/e/TOM to the exact p3 declared definitions before term encoding. expand_declared_abbreviations is the explicit expansion API. First-class stored DECL names are distinct API values from evaluating a named binding. tools/compile_native_source.py preserves exact UTF-8 input, including BOM and newlines, as an external source provenance commitment in both old/proposed history; GPU output retains those bytes. Provenance format: TOMSRC1 followed by NUL, little-endian uint64 UTF-8 length, exact UTF-8 text. No c/e intrinsic opcodes are introduced.
scope: Executes specified structural laws and a declared external continuation relation. It does not supply the dynamics left open on source page 14. Storage records and numeric time units are this finite representation, not an intrinsic ontology.
capacities: Selected at runtime; checked 32-bit word offsets and actual allocation are representation bounds, not intrinsic nesting cutoffs.

flags.2: require exact full source TOM binding
flags.4: select optional source scalar inverse-log echo diagnostic

temporal_relation: Unsigned 64-bit external supplied readings. now>=previous, elapsed=now-previous, latest_available<=now. ADVANCE_TRANSACTION or any consume request requires now>previous. No unit or temporal realization is claimed intrinsic.
external_symbol_ids: Explicitly mapped IDs >=256. IDs 0 and 13..255 are rejected.
aux0: DECL/SELF symbol id; LATER_T external guard id; all other opcodes zero.
term_references: Each used arg points to an earlier record. Every supplied record is checked, including records unreachable from root. No reference cycle is inferred from a declared SELF name.
operand_roles: After licensed normalization: J requires DECL T, INVLOG requires DECL phi, E requires first operand C(...) and second INVLOG(DECL phi). Other compounds require declared arity and SDF closure. Full TOM flag additionally checks exact entire binding and repeated direct role definition equality.
normalization: Same record count and positions. Child IDs replaced by earliest exactly equal normalized representative. Optional DECL A->DECL T. Adjacent IO(IO(e))->IO(e); no other rewrite. Full input remains preserved. Exact equality checks all words, not hashes alone.
guards: Unique IDs. The guard condition and available material are declared external input evidence. They do not authenticate a real-world observation or generate a missing recurrence law.
continuation: Declaration permits a bare self name. Consumption requires LATER_T, a met supplied guard and a supplied result. Missing/false guard is pending; met guard without result is OPEN_LAW. No result is generated.
result_blocks_in_order: term_capacity*8 normalized terms at original positions
blocked_transaction: If any overall status bit is set, otherwise resolved requests become BLOCKED_TRANSACTION and are counted unresolved. Candidate supplied value ID remains inspectable but is not reported available/committed.
history: Complete opaque bytes in supplied order. Old bytes must be the exact complete prefix of proposed bytes; padding is not history. Commit proposed only for status0. Otherwise preserve old bytes available within capacity; output clears final word padding. Source does not prescribe these bytes or tuple units.
invalid_handling: Malformed syntax or capacity failure emits root NONE, normalized count0, zero normalized records, representatives NONE and BAD request codes; original input copy survives. Well-formed terms violating role or full-source requirements retain normalized diagnostics but status INVALID prevents commit.
padding: Zero output padding, unused representatives NONE, unused request identifiers NONE. Entire original fixed-size input copied exactly, including its padding.
scalar_diagnostic: Only explicit flag4 and exact full-source structure prove Arch(c,k*c)=0 for finite real c, k=-ln((1+sqrt(5))/2)<0. This symbolic sign theorem neither approximates a logarithm nor turns the native definition into zero. It proves no jitter dynamics.
